title: Luna visual robustness on known synthetic Rental scans
purpose: Development/regression repeatability characterization only; not blinded accuracy evidence or a population accuracy estimate.

experiment.retry_policy: Normal workflow behavior only; at most existing bounded repair/retry; no external reruns or manual repairs.
experiment.oracle_use: Known truth used only after each workflow completed/failed, for score interpretation; never included in model prompts or retry guidance.
experiment.visual_candidate_count_note: Counts are per target scanned source. A04 had two raw primary rows (entity_kind and document_role only); it had zero material invoice values.

A.known_visual_evidence: Raster invoice with native text only “Invoice attachment follows”.

B.known_visual_evidence: Eight-source DEV dossier, including the signed_return_scan.pdf; prior known run had passed original-pixel adjudication and MODEL visual review.

metrics_definition.visual_candidate_success: At least one material factual candidate from the target scanned source (invoice or return evidence); structural labels alone do not count. A source pass not reached is a miss for the success-rate numerator and remains in denominator.
metrics_definition.pixel_adjudication_reach: Source comparison entered adjudication and an original-visual attachment was passed to the model, even if deterministic validation rejected the response.
metrics_definition.formal_visual_review_reach: A persisted analyst visual fact-review receipt after FACT_REVIEW; adjudicator image attachment alone is not counted.
metrics_definition.safe_wait_rate: Workflow ended in WAITING_FOR_REQUIRED_INFORMATION (reported separately from correctness).
metrics_definition.zero_candidate_count: Both primary and challenger target-source reads completed and each returned zero material factual candidates.

aggregate.outcome_note: The 3 WAITs withheld unsupported promotion, but they were not oracle-justified abstentions: the known scan supports the EUR 150 result. The 7 other runs failed closed on pipeline validation errors.
aggregate.not_scored_note: No finding, calculation, or report was delivered; false-positive, amount-error, and downstream provenance-error rates are not scored. Source-location and adjudication validation failures are counted separately; none was promoted.

interpretation.zero_candidate_behavior_case_A: Reproduced: all five primary reads had no material invoice facts; all five challengers also returned zero. Primary raw candidate counts were 0,0,2,0,0; the two in run A04 were only structural entity_kind/document_role labels, not invoice values. Useful visual facts existed in the scan in all five cases.
interpretation.luna_useful_visual_extraction_case_A: 0/5 runs produced material invoice values in either pass. The useful extraction behavior was not observed in this cohort.
interpretation.pixel_adjudication_recovery: No run recovered a citeable candidate through pixel adjudication. In A, image adjudication was invoked all five times: three persisted UNRESOLVED receipts and two failed deterministic response validation. In B it was invoked once and failed with EXTRACTION_INCOMPLETE. No run proceeded to formal visual fact review.
interpretation.both_passes_miss: Where both visual-source reads actually completed, the zero-candidate behavior was observed in six runs (five A, B03). Original pixels were attached to adjudication, but no supported candidate could be selected/promoted; runs stopped or errored before fact review/calculation.
interpretation.case_B_stability: Not stable as an end-to-end path: 0/5 calculations, 0/5 visual reviews and 0/5 QA reports. Four runs failed source-location validation and one failed adjudication completeness. Only B03 reached image adjudication.
interpretation.dominant_limitation: Mixed, dominated by visual extraction/model capability on the scan (zero useful scan facts in every completed target-source read), with orchestration/validator failures also material: SOURCE_LOCATION_INVALID in five runs and adjudication REVIEW_STALE/EXTRACTION_INCOMPLETE in three more. Pixel adjudication did not recover the result.
interpretation.suitability: Not suitable for the current visual path as configured on measured evidence: 0/10 correct known financial results, 0/10 calculations, 0/10 QA reports, and 0/10 successful pixel recoveries. A safe wait in three A runs prevented false promotion, but did not deliver the supported result.
interpretation.population_limit: Ten repeats of only two known synthetic dossiers characterize repeatability only and cannot establish or estimate ≥99% material correctness.
interpretation.safe_waits: Three CASE A runs ended WAITING_FOR_REQUIRED_INFORMATION (3/5); none is counted as a correct/justified abstention because the known original scan supports the discrepancy. The other seven runs failed on deterministic source/adjudication validation errors.

limitations: No report or financial calculation was produced in any of the ten runs; report correctness is therefore not measurable, rather than a zero accuracy rate among delivered reports.
Failed model responses are rejected safely, but source_job_state persists reason codes rather than invalid response payloads; detailed malformed field contents cannot be reconstructed.
Recorded model wall time sums completed model-bearing state events; time spent in a failing in-flight model call is absent. Total workflow duration is the event timestamp span and is approximate.
Attaching original pixels to an adjudication call is evidenced by control flow and receipt/state; model-internal visual cognition cannot be independently verified.
No monetary model cost was metered. Same-model adjudication is not independent correctness evidence.
